title: Number of Consumers Enjoying Tax Rebates under Commercial Vehicle Emissions Scheme
what_it_is: Number of Consumers Enjoying Tax Rebates under Commercial Vehicle Emissions Scheme

sections.label: CVES extension and incentives
sections.summary: Over 6,700 CVES incentives awarded since 1 April 2021; CVES extended on 15 November 2022 with adjustments and smaller stepdown in incentives.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: More than 6,700 CVES incentives have been awarded since the CVES was implemented on 1 April 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Following our review and consultation with industry, we have announced the extension of the CVES on 15 November 2022 with adjustments to the scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We have taken industry feedback into consideration and extended the CVES with a smaller stepdown in incentives than initially planned.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The revised incentives and surcharge quanta ensure that the total cost of owning and using a cleaner vehicle over its lifespan will continue to be lower than a more pollutive one, maintaining the momentum towards cleaner vehicles.

sections.label: CVES extension and pollutant thresholds
sections.summary: Scheme extended though due to expire; pollutant thresholds adjusted for the Worldwide Harmonised Light Duty Test Procedure adopted from 1 April 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We are happy to see that 6,700 vehicle owners have benefited from that and we hope that the momentum will carry on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: That is why we are extending the scheme even though it was due to expire in a few months' time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We have considered the option of extending the scheme without changing any of the scheme parameters, but there was a need to adjust the pollutant thresholds, to account for the new and more stringent emissions test cycle – which is called the Worldwide Harmonised Light Duty Test Procedure, which will be solely adopted from 1 April 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: This is to ensure that there is sufficient variety of price competitive vehicle models across all the three bands, while continuing to spur the adoption of cleaner energy vehicles.
